shots.p: a young Black mother in her late 20s with freshly done knotless braids neatly styled in a high bun with laid edges and small gold hoop earrings, wearing a cream robe, sitting in a wooden rocking chair in a dim nursery at night holding her newborn baby against her shoulder, eyes closed, tired but peaceful, warm lamp glow, moonlight from window

a Black mother in her mid 30s with a sleek shoulder-length silk press with side part, wearing navy medical scrubs, laughing and hugging her proud 9 year old son in a spotless clean kitchen, purse dropped on the counter, joyful
